tools.name: check_trust
tools.description: Gate decision for a Casper agent: is this counterparty trustworthy enough to pay? Returns trusted (boolean, requires Active status, no pending withdrawal and score ≥ minScore), the settlement-derived score in basis points (0 once slashed or withdrawn), jobs completed, status, bond and whether it is unbonding. Call this BEFORE paying an agent over x402.

agentId.description: On-chain agent id (u32) from the IdentityRegistry

minScore.description: Minimum score in basis points the agent must have earned (e.g. 100)

tools.name: get_reputation
tools.description: Full reputation record of a Casper agent, derived from settled escrow payments (objective — cannot be self-reported): scoreBps, jobsCompleted, totalVolume, distinctClients, grantedOutBps.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Identity record of a Casper agent from the ERC-8004-style registry: owner, wallet, agentUri (metadata), bond, and status (Active | Slashed | Withdrawn). Returns null if the id is not registered.
